method: The decisions rest on coverage-v1332e on candidate 1214cp (Emily as source, product controller, the observer filming from a wider camera 5.6 m away so the caster and the effect point share the frame), with the body presentation already passing in coverage-v1332c/d. 1214cp lets the partner world's clone and spirit visuals run in an armed product session (#104); the host status records the clone created, shown and hidden once with 278 pose updates, and the spirit created, its native effect started and stopped, and hidden. Both are cosmetic: NPC perception of the clone and the spirit's mesmerized targets are NPC authority (stage 4, #14). Lifecycle: every case re-arms the product controller after a checkpoint reload; the 2-hour soak mission-soak-v1316a covers 19 shared restarts and session renewals.

items.scope: Emily casts Doppelganger (power variants 29-31): the partner presents the cast, the native summon effect, a separate clone beside her that moves off on its own, and its retirement.

visual.verdict: A bright summon burst rises beside Emily; a second Emily appears next to her, runs off, and is gone about two seconds later while Emily stands armed.

items.scope: Emily casts Mesmerize without targets (power variants 16-18): the partner presents the enter, aim and release gestures and the native spirit appearing ahead of her, then its dismissal. The mesmerized behaviour of NPC targets is stage 4.

visual.verdict: Emily thrusts her hand forward; a dark, tendrilled spirit forms a few metres ahead of her and hovers there for the rest of the cast.
